messages:
ela_cs: Quick ask — prepping a 1-slide cost spotlight for AuroraMed ahead of their QBR. Need a 90d token forecast, top-10 prompt heatmap, and one recommended renewal ask. Can @mike_fin run the projection and @rachel_se pull prompt-level totals? EOD Fri pls.

mike_fin: Will do. 30d avg: gen ~850k/day, embeds ~220k/day. Recent growth ~8%/mo. Rough 90d proj (no mitigation) ~102M tokens. Tiny snippet below.

mike_fin: ```json
{"30d_gen":850000,"30d_emb":220000,"proj_90d":102000000}
```

rachel_se: Running analytics now. SQL i'll use: ```sql
SELECT prompt_name, SUM(tokens) as tokens, SUM(CASE WHEN type='embed' THEN tokens ELSE 0 END) as embed_tokens
FROM prod_events
WHERE customer_id='auroramed' AND ts > now() - interval '45 days'
GROUP BY prompt_name
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

rachel_se: CSV upload when done -> https://internal.redwood/data/aurora-heat-3127770000.csv

billing-bot: ALERT: AuroraMed at 82% of monthly threshold (threshold=500,000,000 tokens) as of 2026-03-21T11:05:00Z.

ela_cs: Good catch. Add an "immediate mitigations" bullet: (1) temporary throttle at 75% projected, (2) enable request-level batching on top-3 prompts, (3) offer 15% reserved buffer as a near-term ask to Sales.

mike_fin: Initial cost math (public pricing): 90d baseline ~$8.9k. With batching/cache ~20% reduction -> ~$7.1k. 3mo reserved (20% discount) -> effective ~$5.6k and simplifies renewal conversation. I'll drop a small table into the slide notes.

rachel_se: Ops playbook snippet for SREs to paste: ```bash
# enable batching config
redwood config set --customer auroramed --feature batching --value enabled
# apply temporary throttle
redwood rate-limit set --customer auroramed --limit 180r/s
```

ela_cs: Slide plan: 1) exec bullets, 2) burn + 90d proj chart, 3) mitigations & ops snippet, 4) cost table + ask. I will assemble and post draft by Fri 4pm PT.

mike_fin: I'll attach the projection chart before 3:30pm PT.

rachel_se: CSV and heatmap uploaded. No blockers from infra side.

ela_cs: Thanks team — will post the deck link once stitched. :white_check_mark:
